usage: agentware plan verify-premises [-h] [--format {text,json}] --path PATH
                                      [--strict]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --path PATH           path to a plan.md
  --strict              fail-CLOSED on an unresolvable citation for a self-
                        extension plan (used by the loop pre-hook); a
                        reproduced falsification always exits 1 regardless of
                        --strict
